text.insert: How each knowledge source executes: worker-result evidence flows through the always-on background sink, while every other source stages for the operator-initiated sync. All knowledge jobs share one status vocabulary regardless of execution class.

rows: Immutable result evidence; no checkout mutation.
Serialized materializer may advance knowledge during a run.
May use agent workers under the sync lease; need not change source truth.
Stage before sync; publish during sync, as a knowledge-only pass if upstream did not move.
Can invalidate baseline, duplicate local work, and create conflicts.
Publish only with the reconciled sync boundary.
Review evidence is background-safe; source fixes require PR authority.
Separate evidence ingestion from fixer execution.

rows: Durable work exists but has not started.
A processor owns the job lease.
The job is waiting on a dependency or retry time.
Outputs were accepted and provenance was recorded.
The attempt ended without accepted outputs; retry policy determines the next action.
The job was intentionally discarded without deleting accepted prior knowledge.
